div.head: IV Atr 2.12
div.ab: Smeremangestre (que mangonant in caseo et butiro): XIIII diebus ante natale Domini unum den. et septem diebus ante natale (Domini) unum alium.
Smeremangestrae (quae mangonant in caseo et butiro) XIIII diebus ante natale Domini unum den., et septem diebus ante natale Domini unum alium.
Women who deal in dairy produce (i.e. cheese and butter) pay 1 penny a fortnight before Christmas, and another penny a week before Christmas.
Fett[waaren]händlerinnen (welche in Käse und Butter handeln) [zahlen Zoll] 14 Tage vor Weihnachten 1 Pfennig und 7 Tage vor Weihnachten einen zweiten.
Women dealing in fat-goods (who trade in cheese and butter) [pay toll] of 1 penny 14 days before Christmas and a second 7 days before Christmas.
